title: King's Gambit: Falkbeer Countergambit
line: Black answers the gambit with a pawn offer of its own in the center.

steps.text: The King's Gambit. Black does not take: the pawn in front of its queen strikes at your pawn on e4.
Take the pawn. It attacked your pawn on e4.

also.g1f3: That is also played. This lesson takes the pawn.

steps.after: This is the Falkbeer Countergambit. Black pushes its other pawn forward to cramp your pieces.

steps.text: Strike at the forward pawn at once: move the pawn in front of your queen one square.
Take the pawn on e4. You are a pawn up, and the cramping pawn is gone.
steps.after: Black's knight takes back and stands in the center.

steps.text: Bring the knight out. It covers the center squares d4 and e5.
steps.after: The bishop aims at g1, so your king cannot castle on that side.

steps.text: Put your queen on the file of the black king, behind its knight. The knight cannot leave without exposing the king.
steps.after: Black guards the knight with the bishop.

steps.text: Attack the pinned knight with your other knight.

wrong.g2g4: The pawn attacks the bishop, but Black castles, and a rook comes to the file of your queen and king.

steps.after: Black holds for now. You keep the extra pawn, and Black has quick play for it.

summary: Black meets a gambit with a gambit. White takes, breaks up the forward pawn and pins the knight in the center.
